text:
maya patel: Heads up — Helios Bank submitted a special request: they want an *instruct* variant with 100k context support, plus a quantization sweep (int8/int4) to evaluate cost. They need PII-safe handling and plan to deploy on-prem (VPC) later this quarter. Can we run intake + prioritization? @jordan reyes FYI.

cheng liu: Quick clarifying qns: do they want a base->instruct fine-tune, or an instruction-tuned base (no new weights)? Also typical payload pattern: long single-pass documents vs many short queries? that'll drive caching and KV strategy.

maya patel: They prefer instruction-tuned (customer wants safety/guardrails baked in) but are open to a small adapter if cheaper. Primary workload is multi-document legal/finance summaries (~80–100k tokens per request), some embeddings for retrieval.

jordan reyes: On infra side, 100k KV footprint will need checked: current longctx infra (64k prototype) used sharded KV and 40G GPU mem. For 100k we should plan for either sequence-sliced serving or streaming+checkpointing. If they plan on on-prem, we need hw profile + HSM/KMS info before rollout.

sophia ng: Proposal: two-phase bring-up: (1) prototype — 32k->64k extended context with instruct prompt adapter + int8 sweep (smoke evals), (2) heavy validation — full 100k with int4 experiments and regression/eval suite. Timeline estimate: prototype 3w, heavy validation 5–6w. Can parallelize quant sweep with adapter training.

rahul singh: Product note: SLA needed? enterprise will ask for 99.9% and SLOs on tail latencies. Also flagged: compliance team requires redaction tests and synthetic PII evals. We should include a privacy checklist in the intake.

cheng liu: Draft intake checklist below — starting point, lean and actionable:

```
- customer: Helios Bank (finance)
- requested_variant: instruct-100k
- model_base: convai-13B (candidate) / fallback: convai-7B-int8
- training: adapter-tune vs full-tune decision (owner: cheng)
- quantization: int8 sweep (owner: cheng), int4 feasibility experiment (owner: sophia)
- perf targets: p99 latency < 15s for 100k streaming output, cost goal: < $0.35/1k tok
- security: KMS/HSM required, redaction tests (owner: rahul)
- evals: instruct-qa suite, rouge/qa-f1, hallucination rate <= baseline+2%
- regressions: run nightly diff vs prod-instruct baseline; gate on semantic-sim thresholds
- infra: node profile request (24GB HBM min / sharded NVMe fallback), dedicated pool recommended
- rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated fallback
```

jordan reyes: Resource estimate and quick allocation command (draft):

```bash
# reserve a dedicated pool for hel-ctxt-intake
redwood infra reserve --pool hel-ctxt-intake --gpus a100-80gb:4 --region us-west-2 --duration 30d
```

jordan reyes: infra-bot: if on-prem, also capture network egress constraints + IP allowlist; will need CPE ticket before we cut the private package.

infra-bot: noted. Raised ticket REDWOOD-7453 for on-prem package gating.

maya patel: Thanks all — next steps: cheng to own quant plan + eval harness, sophia to start int4 feasibility, jordan to scope infra & open reserve request, rahul to coordinate privacy/redaction tests. I'll compile this into the customer intake doc and send to Helios. :thumbsup: 

cheng liu: Added — I'll link eval PR and a small benchmark artifact when available (expect first smoke results in ~10 business days). :eyes:

sophia ng: Will kick off quant sweep once cheng posts adapter checkpoints.

maya patel: tagging this for prioritization next planning sync.
